# DesignWanted

> > A global design publication showcasing sustainable innovation, architectural excellence, and creative conversations with leading designers and studios.

DesignWanted features in-depth interviews with designers like Sou Fujimoto, Damiano Latini, and Carlo Massoud, alongside coverage of sustainable materials such as ECONYL, Bananatex, and recycled plastics. The platform highlights cutting-edge furniture design, eco-conscious architecture, and circular economy innovations from Italy, Spain, Indonesia, New Zealand, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable materials and circular economy
- Furniture design and product design
- Recycled materials and waste reduction
- Designer interviews and studio profiles
- Eco-design and sustainable furniture
- ECONYL regenerated nylon
- Biophilic and nature-inspired design
- Modular and ergonomic design
- Artisan collaboration
- Italian design innovation
- Indonesian craftsmanship
- Spanish design studios
- Residential architecture
- Eco-engineering solutions
- Material experimentation

## Designer Interviews & Studio Profiles

- [Sou Fujimoto: Creating public sites available to all people](https://designwanted.com/sou-fujimoto-interview): Interview with architect Sou Fujimoto on nature-inspired public design
- [noho is fighting against waste through beautiful design](https://designwanted.com/noho-interview): Interview with NZ-based noho on sustainable furniture using ECONYL
- [Damiano Latini: new bold shapes and modular designs](https://designwanted.com/damiano-latini-bold-shapes-modular-designs): Damiano Latini's modular furniture with recycled plastic at Milan 2023
- [Carlo Massoud: Inspired by the diversity of cultures](https://designwanted.com/interview-carlo-massoud): ECAL graduate Carlo Massoud on cultural diversity in design practice
- [MOOQUE: the emotive power of colors and shapes](https://designwanted.com/mooque-sarunphon-boonto-design): Interview with Bangkok designer Mooque on storytelling through color & form
- [Yonoh studio: designing with a Valencian attitude](https://designwanted.com/yonoh-studio-valencian-attitude-design): Interview with Valencia's Yonoh studio on Spanish product design approach
- [Giulio Masotti: combining digital and physical realms](https://designwanted.com/interview-giulio-masotti): Giulio Masotti on Wood-Skin, FOLIO and Materea design ventures

## Sustainable Materials & Circular Economy

- [Bananatex: a material from the fibers of Abacá banana plants](https://designwanted.com/bananatex-qwestion-abaca-banana-fibers): QWSTION's Bananatex: biodegradable textile from Philippine banana fibers
- [ZZBOZHZHA: how to reinvent materiality in sustainable design](https://designwanted.com/zbozhzha-reinvent-materiality-sustainable-design): ZBOZHZHA studio's handcrafted lamps using experimental recycled materials
- [Loll Designs: What does it mean to be a sustainable company?](https://designwanted.com/loll-designs-sustainable-manufacturing-company): Loll Designs' sustainable outdoor furniture from recycled HDPE plastic
- [ECOncrete is an alternative to traditional flood defences](https://designwanted.com/econcrete-concrete-rock-pools): ECOncrete's Maor Bezner on Coastalock eco-engineering flood defenses

- [Meii Estudio: architecture and aerospace engineering](https://designwanted.com/meii-estudio-modulo-habitat-architecture): Meii Estudio's Modulo Habitat merges aerospace engineering with architecture
